events.title: Kuehne + Nagel Lifts Lower-End of Earnings Guidance
events.body: The transport and logistics company said the Middle East conflict hurt first-quarter sea freight volumes, but its air, road and contract logistics businesses had a strong start to the year.

events.title: Kuehne + Nagel Reports Sharp Drop in Earnings Amid Deteriorating Environment
events.body: The transport and logistics company’s recurring earnings before interest and tax—a preferred profitability measure—fell 17% on year.
